Applying <stasis/>Slow to a target grants <pve 300% /> <pvp [150%] /> Increased Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds. 

Dodging applies <pve 60x /> <pvp [40x] /> Slow to enemies in a <pve 9 /> <pvp [8] /> meter radius for <pve 8 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds (<pve 12 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance).

Grants 50% Damage Resistance against Combatants for 4 seconds after the dodge.
